name: L3 动画流程
description: L3 动画制作流程：制作角色动画、过场动画、UI动效。输出 PNG 序列帧或 Spritesheet。需要 Windows MCP Runner。
author: Pipeline-Sys

character_id.description: 角色 ID（角色动画时使用）

nodes.name: 参数接收
nodes.expression: ({ task_id: inputs.task_id, title: inputs.title, animation_type: inputs.animation_type, character_id: inputs.character_id, animation_name: inputs.animation_name, frame_count: inputs.frame_count, frame_rate: inputs.frame_rate, output_mode: inputs.output_mode, execution_runtime: 'windows', requires_mcp: true, output_format: 'PNG', started_at: new Date().toISOString() })

nodes.name: 加载动画规格
nodes.description: 读取动画系统规格文档

nodes.name: 生成关键帧提示词
nodes.description: 为每一帧生成 AI 提示词
nodes.expression: (function() { const frameCount = ${inputs.frame_count}; const animName = '${inputs.animation_name}'; const charId = '${inputs.character_id}'; const basePrompt = 'pixel art animation frame, cyberpunk noir style, consistent character design, 16-bit aesthetic'; const keyframes = []; for (let i = 0; i < frameCount; i++) { keyframes.push({ frame: i + 1, prompt: basePrompt + ', frame ' + (i + 1) + ' of ' + frameCount + ', ' + animName + ' animation' + (charId ? ', character ' + charId : '') }); } return { keyframes, total_frames: frameCount, animation_name: animName }; })()

nodes.name: 生成单帧
nodes.command:
echo 'Generating frame ${loop.keyframe.frame}/${inputs.frame_count}'
echo 'Animation: ${inputs.animation_name}'
echo 'Prompt: ${loop.keyframe.prompt}'
echo 'Output: assets/images/animations/${inputs.character_id || inputs.animation_type}/${inputs.animation_name}_frame_${loop.keyframe.frame}.png'
# TODO: 实际调用 MCP 生成

nodes.name: 合成 Spritesheet
nodes.command:
echo 'Creating spritesheet from ${inputs.frame_count} frames'
echo 'Layout: ${inputs.frame_count}x1 grid'
echo 'Output: assets/images/spritesheets/${inputs.character_id || inputs.animation_type}_${inputs.animation_name}.png'
# TODO: 使用 ImageMagick 或 canvas 合成 spritesheet
# montage frame_*.png -tile ${inputs.frame_count}x1 -geometry +0+0 spritesheet.png

nodes.name: 验证资源
nodes.description: 验证动画资源格式和帧数

nodes.name: 更新资源注册表
Git 提交
nodes.command: git add assets/images/animations/ assets/images/spritesheets/ src/data/asset-registry.json && git commit -m "${inputs.task_id}: ${inputs.title} [L3_animator]" && git push origin HEAD || echo 'No changes to commit'

body.title: 动画任务完成
